title: Realistic seed and demo data
when: An app needs believable demo content, test fixtures, or enough records to see how lists, charts and paging behave.
prompt:
Goal: Deterministic, varied, plausible records from a seeded script, covering edge cases, with no real people data.
Steps:
1. Use a seeded PRNG (mulberry32 with a fixed seed) so every run produces the same data.
2. Small domain vocabularies for the locale (first names, streets, products with real price ranges).
3. Realistic distributions: mostly small orders and a few large, weekday peaks, dates over the 90 days before a fixed base date.
4. Deliberate edge cases: very long names, accents, empty optional fields, zero amounts, values at filter boundaries.
5. Keep relations valid (every foreign id exists; totals equal their lines); use example.com emails and fictional phone ranges.
6. Write pretty JSON (or CSV) and note seed and count at the top of the generator.
Quality bar:
- Looks real in screenshots without being real.
- Re-running gives identical files.
- Volume is configurable (20 for demos, 5 thousand for load).
Pitfalls:
- Filler text or "Test User 1" everywhere.
- All dates today, hiding sort and grouping bugs.
- Random ids that break references between files.
Verify:
- [ ] Seeded generator with a fixed base date.
- [ ] Output JSON parses.
- [ ] References resolve.
- [ ] Edge case records present.
Output: scripts/seed.mjs writing data/seed.json (and optionally data/seed.csv).

examples.input: gera dados de exemplo para minha loja: clientes e pedidos
examples.output: seed.mjs with mulberry32(42), 50 clientes, 300 pedidos over 90 days, valid customerIds
